name: PhysAI Robot Starter
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends libosmesa6-dev libgl1 libegl1 && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
postCreateCommand: pip install uv && uv sync --locked --extra web --extra dev && (uv run python scripts/fetch_assets.py --robot so101 || echo 'Asset fetch failed; rerun: uv run python scripts/fetch_assets.py --robot so101')
